say:1:1131031001:1.text: It has to be me. Are we really going to let the younglings go instead?
say:1:1131031001:1.source_cn: 当然得我来，不然难道让族里这些小娃娃去？
say:1:1131031001:1.male: It has to be me. Are we really going to let the younglings go instead?
say:1:1131031001:1.female: It has to be me. Are we really going to let the younglings go instead?

say:2:1131031002:1.text: I'll rest for a few days before going back out to hunt. We'll need many bones and hides to build tents.
say:2:1131031002:1.source_cn: 休息几天，我就继续去外面猎兽。还需要很多兽皮和兽骨来重...
say:2:1131031002:1.male: I'll rest for a few days before going back out to hunt. We'll need many bones and hides to build tents.
say:2:1131031002:1.female: I'll rest for a few days before going back out to hunt. We'll need many bones and hides to build tents.

say:3:1131031003:1.text: It feels great to say that I'll never leave home again, but I must fulfill my duty to the clan.
say:3:1131031003:1.source_cn: 至于“再也不离开部族”这种话嘛，感慨而已，听听就好！部...

say:3:1131031003:1.female: It feels great to say that I'll never leave home again, but I must fulfill my duty to the clan.
